summary: AI suggests category and routing for incoming Zendesk tickets; agent confirms.
transcript: We get about 312 tickets per month and categorise and route them by hand. I want AI to suggest the category and the right person. All 4 people in support would use it. It would save maybe half a day per week each. Our numbers come from Zendesk reports. One developer for about a month, Zendesk has an API.

impact.evidence: save maybe half a day per week each

confidence.evidence: Our numbers come from Zendesk reports

effort.evidence: One developer for about a month

summary: Chatbot on the website answers customer questions from the help centre before a ticket is opened.
transcript: Customers keep asking the same things about connectivity and logins. A chatbot on our website could answer from the help centre articles. Around 150 customers a month would use it. It could cut repeat tickets a lot, that is a 2027 goal. I think, from my experience, it takes two people about two months.

reach.evidence: Around 150 customers a month would use it

impact.evidence: cut repeat tickets a lot, that is a 2027 goal

summary: Send a reorder alert when a part falls below a minimum stock level.
transcript: We had two stock-outs this year. When a part goes below the minimum level, the system should email procurement. The 3 people in operations use it. The rule is simple: below the minimum, reorder. Based on the stock sheet. Maybe one week of work.

reach.evidence: The 3 people in operations use it

impact.evidence: We had two stock-outs this year

summary: AI scores and ranks job applicants' CVs so People & Culture only reads the top ten.
transcript: For each open role we get around 60 CVs. AI could score and rank them so I only read the top ten. It would save me a lot of time. That is a guess. A few weeks with an external tool.

impact.evidence: save me a lot of time

effort.evidence: A few weeks with an external tool

summary: Detect support agents' stress from their webcam during calls.
transcript: We could use the webcam to detect when support agents are stressed during calls and give them a break. 4 people. It would help a bit. Just a guess. About a month.
We should use AI in sales somehow, everyone is doing it.

open_questions: Which sales task should AI help with?

summary: Predict sensor and gateway failures from device health logs so support can act before customers notice.
transcript: We have 12 months of device health logs in AWS. A model could predict which sensors will fail soon so we contact the customer first. That affects maybe 400 customer sites a month. It supports the goal of fewer support tickets. We know the failure counts from RMA data. Two engineers for two months.

impact.evidence: supports the goal of fewer support tickets

confidence.evidence: We know the failure counts from RMA data

summary: Predict the chance of winning a public tender before writing the response.
transcript: Before we answer a tender we could predict if we will win. We write maybe 3 tenders a month. It would help us focus. I am guessing here. Maybe one month of work.
